status.label: Unsupported redirected Local profile scenario
status.detail: Command Palette stopped launching only after the entire user Local profile was moved to another drive and junction-linked back, an unsupported environment change outside PowerToys installation behavior.

next_action.label: Document the unsupported environment boundary
next_action.reason: No PowerToys code design is justified from this report.

judgment.rationale: The reporter confirms Command Palette worked until `%LOCALAPPDATA%` was manually relocated with robocopy and a junction. Reinstalling PowerToys cannot restore assumptions broken by redirecting the whole Local profile.
evidence: The issue includes screenshots and a diagnostic ZIP.
Other PowerToys features continue to work.
The failure began immediately after moving the Local folder and creating a junction to another drive.
A maintainer explicitly notes that this is highly irregular and not an installation mode PowerToys supports.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat the manually redirected profile as an unsupported environment rather than start a new fix design.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code fix is not applicable to an unsupported whole-profile relocation performed outside the installer and Windows profile-redirection mechanisms.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette stopped launching only after the entire user Local profile was moved to another drive and junction-linked back, an unsupported environment change outside PowerToys installation behavior.
known_information: PowerToys itself is installed on the D drive.
Command Palette reports an invalid parameter after the Local profile junction change.
The extension worked before the profile migration.
inferences: Packaged-app activation or path canonicalization may reject the redirected profile, but supporting arbitrary manual profile junctions would have broader Windows packaging implications.
issue_context.analysis: The issue-specific causal transition is clear and external to supported setup. No additional upstream action is proposed by this artifact.
initial_investigation: Read both comments, screenshots references, and the diagnostic link.
Checked for linked fixes or duplicates and found none.
Separated the unsupported profile-junction condition from normal non-system-drive PowerToys installation.
